notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S126 (24 hr fuel): pump 60 / 245 / 45, 10 from the top; 24 in 60 E (112) + 45 + hr 60 E lower case (75), baseline 330. Layout: 350 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol fuel pump symbol S3 at 70 % (245 x 245) x 67-288 y 31-238; 24 60 E white top 270 x 60-172 (111); hr 60 E white top 270 x 216-291 (75).
